description: This file contains initialization routines and helper functions for testing Gitweb, a web interface for Git repositories. It includes functions to set up configuration, run tests, and checks for prerequisites such as Perl modules and Gitweb installation.
external_files: perl scripts and configuration files referenced within, such as gitweb_config.perl, description file at .git/description

methods.name: gitweb_init
methods.description: Initializes configuration for Gitweb tests, creates configuration files, and sets SCRIPT_NAME based on environment variables.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Executes a Gitweb CGI script with specified query parameters, capturing headers and output for testing purposes.
